title: security: rbac-v2 KMS region residency & audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated regions requested stronger enforcement of KMS region residency and more explicit audit logging for RBAC v2 policy evaluation. This PR hardens KMS region pinning enforcement, expands audit trail entries for KMS operations, and closes a gap where fallback keys could be used without explicit region consent.

Summary of changes: Upgrades RBAC v2 policy validator to enforce KMS key region residency rules, introduces an explicit KMS operation audit event type, adds migration to flag existing keys with ambiguous residency metadata, and wires through enforcement flags to the private deployment installer and runtime policy engine. Includes tests and docs updates.

Checklist: - [x] Enforce region pinning in policy evaluation path - [x] Emit structured audit events for KMS operations (encrypt/decrypt/sign) - [x] Backfill migration to tag keys lacking residency metadata - [x] E2E test in dedicated staging with simulated cross-region keys - [x] Release notes and rollout plan

Why this change: Previously RBAC v2 allowed implicit use of KMS keys when model/data residency constraints were present but not annotated on keys. That could lead to accidental cross-region usage in Private installations. This hardening makes region residency explicit and provides clear audit trails for compliance reviews.

Rollout: Feature gated behind "rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce" flag. Default behavior after merge: flag off for 48 hours, monitoring and automated canary (10% traffic to enforce), manual enable per-customer for Private installs. Full on for Dedicated/Hosted after 7 days if no major issues.

Notes: This is not a breaking API change for customers using the hosted API, but Private installations with keys missing residency metadata will see audit warnings and will be prompted to run the migration tool included.
